propositions: A new peer confirmation store module must persist records of managed links as they are added outbound, keyed by (source_local_id, target_local_id, relation) with fields for link_id, direction, confirmed_pass, confirmed_at, and source.

The write seam at dispatch_apply_phases._update_one_dispatch_links must invoke an optional link_confirm callback after set_relationship succeeds, capturing the returned link_id, with all callback exceptions logged and swallowed to preserve link application semantics.

The confirmation store must be staged in both _rel_files and _tracked_basenames in reconcile_helpers to ensure confirmation-only changes are committed; staging in _rel_files alone is insufficient due to the per-file idempotency guard.
Unbound targets (when binding_store.get_local_id returns None) must not record confirmation, preventing vendor keys from being persisted in local-id fields.
The store must load fail-OPEN: corrupt or absent peer_confirmations.json degrades to an empty store without raising, and is recovered on subsequent passes or by snapshot backfill.
